permitted_materials_used: the 15 anonymous crops generated from the assigned boxes

procedure.rotations: none; the principal writing in every box is upright

notes: All 15 anonymous crops were inspected independently. The source underlining, cancellations, interlinear replacements, short forms, signs and foliation are retained. The main open places are obscured cancelled text, compressed word endings, the small subscript in B010 and the right-hand mark in B012. No witness or first-pass text was consulted, and no comparison was run.

boxes.scope: The complete sa multiplicité en D-alpha phrase.
boxes.evidence: The long underline lies under multiplicité. Its last tall crossed t and separate acute support the written ending. The D has a small alpha at its lower right, followed by a separate full stop.

boxes.scope: The three complete groups on this line.
boxes.evidence: The first group has a looped d followed by low on/c traces; the next has a d loop and e tail. The last group starts with a small rounded loop and ends with a low rising return.
boxes.uncertainty: ce is preferred for the final group, but the small joined strokes do not securely exclude en. No grammatical repair was made.

boxes.scope: The cancelled lower fragment and the live upper replacement.
boxes.evidence: A broad parenthesis-like curve stands at the left of the lower fragment, followed by a tall loop and low joined strokes, crossed by a horizontal cancellation. Above it, et has a broad e curve and a tall crossed t.
boxes.uncertainty: The lower fragment may read (les; its interior letters and even the independence of the opening parenthesis-like stroke remain uncertain. No balancing parenthesis has been supplied.
boxes.attachment: et is written above the cancelled lower fragment at this position.

boxes.scope: The cancelled voit que and the elevated replacement; clipped neighboring descenders at the top and bottom are excluded.
boxes.evidence: The crossed lower phrase has a dotted i and tall crossed terminal t in voit, followed by q with its long descender and low ue. The higher word has re, a large g loop, low ar, and a tall d.
boxes.uncertainty: The final low loops and terminal dot-like trace permit regardons, but could also be read as regarder followed by a stop. The cancellation of voit que is clear.
boxes.attachment: The replacement starts above the cancelled phrase and continues to its right.

boxes.scope: The complete alpha, word, comma and i.e. group.
boxes.evidence: The first small glyph has a low loop with a right tail, read as alpha. The next word begins with a long descending stem and right arch; its compact middle has small raised strokes, and it ends with an s-like curve. A separate comma precedes i.e., whose stops are visible.
boxes.uncertainty: pris is preferred from the p-like initial stem and terminal s; fixés remains possible because the small middle strokes are compressed.

boxes.scope: The complete principal line; clipped extension lettering from the preceding line is excluded.
boxes.evidence: déduite has two d forms, a dotted i and crossed t with a following low return. The comma is separate. comme has the rounded initial co and low m/e forms. tout has two tall crossed stems with low intervening letters. The last group begins with a p descender and long low continuation.
boxes.uncertainty: The last word is read pour, with par retained because the compressed low letters are not all separable.

boxes.evidence: courbe has the low cour strokes, a tall b and a low final e. The following adjective has a tall l and t; the last glyph has a long descending loop and several cross/return strokes, favoring final f.
boxes.uncertainty: relatif is preferred, with relative retained because the final retracing does not separate every stroke securely. The agreement has not been normalized.

boxes.scope: The complete main formula/prose line; clipped previous-line and next-line traces are excluded.
boxes.evidence: The first U has subscript D-alpha; the following D has the same small alpha. A single separate horizontal dash precedes ou. The second U has s-alpha below it. The complete words sur un follow. The dash is not transcribed as an arrow or equality.

boxes.scope: The complete des, cancelled word, and following short form. A clipped descender at the top is excluded.
boxes.evidence: The live initial group has a looped d and low es. The cancelled word contains an s-like start, a tall t and a separate dot consistent with i, but much of its low body lies under the strike. The following abbreviation has a p descender, tall t and a separate short terminal black mark.
boxes.uncertainty: sections is tentative in the cancelled word. The final short form is provisionally pt. rather than pts; the small terminal mark could be a very compressed s.

boxes.scope: The entire principal rat. sur ... on n’a line; clipped neighboring lines are excluded.
boxes.evidence: The opening rat has a tall t and separate stop. The field expression shows k, parentheses, s and a small alpha. de precedes U. A single dash precedes the low on n’a letters; the apostrophe is visible.
boxes.uncertainty: The small subscript under U is crowded. s-alpha is preferred; a longer k(s-alpha) reading is retained as an alternative because an extra initial stroke cannot be securely separated.

boxes.scope: The complete principal qu’un pt : l’infini line, plus the wholly visible interlinear maintenant on the next level. Clipped B010 context above is excluded.
boxes.evidence: pt has no independent full stop before the two vertically arranged colon dots. l’infini has its apostrophe, long f descender and dotted i forms. The formula has i-alpha, membership, X with s-alpha, a separate descending set-difference slash, and U with s-alpha, followed by a comma.
boxes.attachment: The separate second TSV line records the visible interlinear maintenant without attaching it to the preceding formula. Its leader and actual attachment to dispose ... d’un are fully read in B013.

boxes.scope: The complete rat sur field-like expression and final stop; clipped upper descender excluded.
boxes.evidence: rat has a tall crossed t but no separate following stop in this crop. The main field-like letter has a straight left stem and two right branches, followed by a small alpha below. To its right is a smaller two/three-turn xi-like mark with a separate raised dot. A distinct final stop is farther right.
boxes.uncertainty: The case of the first letter and the interpretation of the smaller right-hand mark are unresolved. The tentative whole readings preserve that mark and its raised dot; no mathematical meaning or standard field notation is asserted.

boxes.scope: The full dispose ... d’un passage and the inserted maintenant. The formula fragments above are clipped context.
boxes.evidence: dispose has its looped d, p descender and low ose continuation. maintenant has the dotted i and tall t forms. The leader curves from immediately before d’un up and right beneath the inserted word.
boxes.attachment: The leader attaches maintenant between dispose and d’un, not to the formula above.

boxes.scope: Both final source lines, including the small line close to the bottom paper edge.
boxes.evidence: L has subscript i and is followed by a C-shaped inclusion sign and pi. relatif ends with the long f descender. A colon precedes cet i-alpha, then the separated commas and justement. The lower line reads de façon ess. canonique, retaining the short form and stop.
boxes.edge_note: The lower q descender approaches the image/paper edge, but the word body and terminal comma remain visible. No further text is supplied beyond the edge.
boxes.state_note: The horizontal stroke at façon is read as the long f crossbar/joins; no independent cancellation stroke is securely distinguishable.

boxes.evidence: A closed upper loop with descending tail gives 9; the following digit has two rightward bends and a low return, giving 3. The black lower image border is excluded.
